answer_1.quote: We validate the proposed gating mechanisms on three popular translation tasks: IWSLT14 German to English (DE-EN), IWSLT15 English to Vietnamese (EN-VI), and Multi30K DE-EN.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs of our systems require the least amount of modification to be converted into reference sequences.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we comprehensively validate previous methods and the proposed methods with popular translation evaluation metrics: BLEU , METEOR (Banerjee and Lavie, 2005), Word Error Rate (WER), ROUGE-L , and NIST .
